## Reusable rules

1. **Keep documentation claims aligned with the declared schema** If documentation says a request variant is unsupported, either exclude it from the TypeSpec union or revise the documentation; ensure the generated contract presents the same constraint. *Scope:* TypeSpec documentation for request models and their generated OpenAPI schemas. *Explicit reviewer guidance.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/pull/46530#discussion_r4109615170

2. **Document operation behavior and request workflows** Explain what an operation does and what callers should provide or expect, including distinctions such as configuring an evaluation versus running it, pagination defaults, and asynchronous status monitoring. *Scope:* Documentation for Foundry evaluation operations and request models; adapt details to each API's actual contract. *Inferred lesson.* Evidence: https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/e2cb5d624e099b798e284930bed567f09dd23389/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/openai/evaluations/models.tsp, https://github.com/Azure/azure-rest-api-specs/blob/e2cb5d624e099b798e284930bed567f09dd23389/specification/ai-foundry/data-plane/Foundry/src/openai/evaluations/routes.tsp
